scheme_name: Cycle Scheme for the Children of Construction Workers (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered building or construction worker under the Punjab Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a year
Applicant must not be a member of any other welfare fund established under any law
Applicant must not be a member of EPF, NPS, or ESIC
Applicant must not be an income tax payer
Beneficiary must be a child of a registered construction worker
Beneficiary must be studying in class 9th to 12th in Punjab
Beneficiary must not have received a bicycle under the Mai Bhago Cycle Scheme
benefits_summary: One free cycle is provided to eligible children of registered construction workers studying in classes 9th to 12th.
